why: The action deleted by id after asking only for delete:note:own. The notes page already picks delete:note:own for the owner and delete:note:any for anyone else. The smallest fix is that same choice in the action.

decision: Re-ran the delete tests after the action change
why: The same three tests that failed on main have to pass on the branch.

decision: Posted the same four deletes to the running app after the action change
why: The ticket is about the request, not only the test. A regular user's delete of someone else's note must be rejected and the note must remain.

why: The old checker exited 2 because it still described an action that never reads ownerId. The new checker reads the ownership expression from the action and compares that choice with the notes page. The promise did not change.

why: A pass is not enough if the checker can no longer fail. Swapping own and any must still be a mismatch. Removing the ownership expression must exit 2. The action file was restored from git after both breaks.
